source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of access modifiers (PDF 58).

blocks.text: Access modifiers woh tareeqe hain jo tay karte hain ke class, us ke methods aur variables tak kaun pohanch sakta hai. Python mein yeh naam ke tareeqe (underscore) se tay hote hain:

items: Public: aise attributes aur methods jo class ke bahar se bhi istemal ho sakte hain (naam bina underscore).

blocks.text:
class Car:
    def __init__(self , color): self.color = color # Public property

items: Protected: jo class ke andar aur us ki subclasses (us se bani classes) mein istemal hon (naam ek underscore se shuru, jaise _protected_var).

blocks.text:
class Car:
    def __init__(self): self._protected_var = 20 # Protected variable

blocks.title: Dhyan dein
blocks.text: Python protected ko zabardasti nahi rokti: _protected_var bahar se bhi parha ja sakta hai. Ek underscore sirf programmers ke liye ishara hai ke "isay bahar se na chhuein".

items: Private: jo class ke bahar se seedhe istemal na ho sakein. Private attribute ke naam ke shuru mein do underscores lagayein (__color).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab private wali misaal ko paragraph ke andar ek hi line mein chhapti hai (class Car: def __init__...), aur self.__color wali line margin par; aise SyntaxError aata hai. Sahi tarteeb oopar hai: har line alag aur theek indentation ke saath. (Wahan ek faltu number "2.8.1.3" bhi chhap gaya hai.)
__color private hai, yani class ke bahar se seedha nahi parha ja sakta (car.__color likhne par AttributeError aata hai). Is ke liye get_color() method istemal hota hai, jo value wapas deta hai.

Wazahat: pehli misaal mein Car class ka public attribute color hai jo seedha istemal hota hai. Private wali misaal mein __color sirf get_color() ke zariye milta hai: Car("red").get_color() se "red" aata hai.

blocks.prompt: Class ke bahar ka code private attribute kaise parh sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Class ke public method, jaise get_color(), ke zariye, seedhe nahi.

items: Public: color; protected: _color (sirf ishara); private: __color (bahar se seedha nahi).
